name: HyperFrames
summary: A framework for turning HTML, CSS, media and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos, built for agents: a CLI to preview and render, skills that teach an agent to compose videos, and a catalog of blocks such as transitions, overlays and animated charts.

agent_entrypoints.what: Index of the docs (https://hyperframes.heygen.com/_llms/docs.txt) and of the block catalog (https://hyperframes.heygen.com/_llms/catalog.txt). Follow each index to the page you need.
One skill, e.g. .../skills/hyperframes/SKILL.md (composing a video) or .../skills/hyperframes-cli/SKILL.md (the CLI). Read the core one before writing a composition.
Scaffolds a video project; `npx hyperframes preview` opens a live preview and `npx hyperframes render` writes the MP4. Run with HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 (see notes).

use_when: A product needs a demo video, launch clip or social video and the team would rather write HTML and CSS than learn a video editor.
Interface motion or a UI walkthrough should become a video that renders the same every time.
An animated chart or data story is needed as a video file rather than a live page.
avoid_when: You are building the interface itself. This renders video; it is indexed for the marketing and demo half of shipping UI.
You need AI-generated footage, voice or music without paying - those come from HeyGen's models (the Studio app's Pro plan, or a HeyGen account for media-use), not from the open-source framework.
The environment has no Node 22 or cannot run a headless browser to render frames.

provides.name: hyperframes
provides.note: Read first: the render contract, the work loop and what each kind of video needs.

provides.name: hyperframes-cli
provides.note: Scaffold, check frames, edit timelines, preview, render and share.

provides.name: hyperframes-registry
provides.note: About 450 ready-made blocks installed as editable source: transitions, titles, captions, charts.

provides.name: media-use
provides.note: Getting or making music, images, voiceover and footage for a video, with HeyGen or free local tools.

provides.name: reverse-any-video
provides.note: Rebuilds an existing video as an editable project, checked frame by frame.

provides.name: style-sampling
provides.note: A new episode in one of a few proven explainer styles.

provides.name: slideshow
provides.note: A deck to present live, served by `hyperframes present`. Installed on demand.

provides.name: figma
provides.note: Brings Figma assets, tokens and frames into a video. Installed on demand.

provides.name: remotion-to-hyperframes
provides.note: Ports Remotion, Lottie, Motion Canvas or plain CSS animation. Installed on demand.

baseline.description: AI video you can actually edit. HyperFrames is a free, open-source AI video editor. Describe any video and get a real project you can change down to the frame.

notes: Category outlier, like ComfyUI: indexed for the media that ships alongside an interface. The CLI sends anonymous usage data to PostHog by default; set HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1. The framework is Apache-2.0 with no per-render fees; the separate Studio app has a paid Pro plan.
